newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Dawson County SD, Ga.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Dawson County School District (Georgia)
General Obligation Sales Tax School Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids will be received by Dawson County School District (Georgia) pursuant to the Official Notice of Sale, dated April 28, 1997.
Sale Date: Tuesday, May 6, 1997
Sale Time: 11:00 a.m. (Eastern Daylight Time)
Sale Location: Atlanta, Georgia (facsimile bids will be accepted)
Bonds Dated: May 1, 1997
Interest Payments: April 1 and October 1, commencing
April 1, 1998
Maturity: Payable October 1, 1998 through 2002
Redemption Provisions: The Bonds are not subject to
redemption prior to maturity.
Bank Qualification: The Bonds have been designated
qualified tax- exempt obligations'' within the meaning
of Section
265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of
as amended.
Rating: Standard & Poor's rating applied for
Legal Opinion: King & Spalding, Atlanta, Georgia

The Bonds are being issued by the School District to provide funds to acquire, construct and equip one elementary school. The Bonds are payable first from the proceeds of a one percent sales and use tax and then from an ad valorem tax, unlimited as to rate or amount, to be levied upon all property within the School District subject to taxation for school bond purposes. For copies of the Preliminary Official Statement in deemed final form, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Forms, please contact the School District's Financial Advisor, A.G. Edwards & Sons, Inc., Atlanta, Georgia at (404) 237-3280.
(From The Bond Buyer)
